target_text:
I believe working alone is better because,people won't be bothering you, you can listen to music, and also you can work on your own pace. Imagaine your teacher gave your class an assignment and you were told you can work alone or you can work in a group. I would work by myself because i find it much easier to work, you don't have to worry about other people rushing you to finish so they can turn it in already or when your trying to listen to music but they're just talking about the most random things so you can't really focus.

My first reason is people won't be bothering you when your working. While your working you might have your headphones in and not wanting to be bother anyone and just trying to finish your assignment quick.You might be distrubed by some of your classmates but having your headphones it won't bother you that much you could judt ignore it and just continue your work.

My second reason you can listen to music, When i'm working by myself i would always listen to music cause it always helps me to finish my work and also it tunes out the distrastions from the other students.And it also just helps you to be relax and so you can just ease through everything without problems or anything. My final reason is you can work on your own pace, When your working in a group you have to make sure eveyone is caught up with you or with the others and it just takes away time or if they're goofing around and not doing their work or their distracted and aren't doing their work while your doing eveything you'll have to wait till they are coping or trying to finish everything. But working by yourself and on your own pace you could finish in time with having to wait for someone else to get caught up or having to wait for someone to finish talking with their friend.

Working in a group, you can help eachother in an assignment or if your stuck on something you can just ask a friend for help.But i still prefer working alone than working in a group. This is my reason why i believe working alone is better than working in a group.You get more focus, don't have to wait for anyone, you have time for yourself, you can work on your own pace, listen to your music, and other things.But others might think working in a group is better cause you get things done faster, you get to talk with your friends, help each other with ideas, and other things too.
